#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack quarterly_report.docx (stdlib only) and summarize paragraph styles/text
to identify which paragraphs are headlines."""
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom

SRC = "quarterly_report.docx"
OUT = "unpacked"

def extract():
    out = Path(OUT)
    if out.exists():
        import shutil
        shutil.rmtree(out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zf:
        zf.extractall(out)

def main():
    extract()
    dom = minidom.parse(str(Path(OUT) / "word" / "document.xml"))
    body = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:body")[0]
    paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
    print(f"total paragraphs: {len(paras)}")
    for i, p in enumerate(paras):
        style = ""
        pPrs = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
        if pPrs:
            styles = pPrs[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
            if styles:
                style = styles[0].getAttribute("w:val")
        texts = []
        for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
            if t.firstChild:
                texts.append(t.firstChild.data)
        for d in p.getElementsByTagName("w:delText"):
            if d.firstChild:
                texts.append(d.firstChild.data)
        text = "".join(texts).strip()
        print(f"[{i}] style={style!r} text={text[:90]!r}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
